root_cause.text: KVM SVM omitted LBR-related MSRs (MSR_IA32_DEBUGCTLMSR, MSR_IA32_LASTBRANCHFROMIP, MSR_IA32_LASTBRANCHTOIP, MSR_IA32_LASTINTFROMIP, MSR_IA32_LASTINTTOIP) from the save/restore MSR list and writable MSR handling, causing complete loss of LBR state during migration or save/restore operations.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message states "MSR_IA32_DEBUGCTLMSR and LBR MSRs are currently not enumerated by KVM_GET_MSR_INDEX_LIST, and LBR MSRs cannot be set with KVM_SET_MSRS. So save/restore is completely broken." The patch adds these MSRs to `msrs_to_save_base` in `arch/x86/kvm/x86.c` and adds write handling in `svm_set_msr()` guarded by `lbrv` checks.
